necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with a history of atherosclerotic heart disease, documented under diagnosis code I25.10, and reports intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by dizziness and giddiness. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes in the context of known coronary artery disease. This monitoring is clinically necessary to evaluate the etiology of the patient's symptoms and guide further management.
